description: This file defines authentication and key generation functions for a proxy service using FastAPI. It includes functions to authenticate API keys based on environment variables and generate keys based on provided data, with logic to enforce rules related to team IDs.

methods.name: UserAPIKeyAuth user_api_key_auth(request: Request, api_key: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user API key by comparing it against a modified master key derived from environment variables.

methods.name: generate_key_fn(data: GenerateKeyRequest)
methods.description: Decides if a key should be generated based on the provided data, primarily checking for the presence of a team ID.

ctags.name: user_api_key_auth
ctags.pattern: /^async def user_api_key_auth(request: Request, api_key: str) -> UserAPIKeyAuth:$/
